about: Indirect-fire cadence, range and spread for turn-based play (SPEC §10). A class fires one volley every usage_turns turns. Shells per volley = CoH3 damage rate over that time ÷ CoH3 damage per shell, rounded up; accuracy carries the rounding. Range = CoH3 metres ÷ 7, capped. Each shell lands on a random hex within spread_hex of the aimed hex (0 = the aimed hex). Classes match weapon / ability / squad ids by pattern, first match wins. Minimum range = round(CoH3 min ÷ CoH3 max × our range), at least min_range_floor_hex. max_shells caps a normal-fire volley (rockets). Blind fire (target hex not seen): accuracy ÷ CoH3 scatter fow_angle × fow_distance multipliers and spread + blind.extra_spread_hex. Counter-battery: a hex an indirect weapon fired from is sound-ranged for the opponent for counter_battery.mark_turns turns; firing at it is not blind.
